description: Swim gently in place, facing LEFT for the whole loop. The long thin body makes a subtle travelling S wave. The TWO separate tail stalks and their complete crescent tails flutter alternately with a small phase offset; upper cyan tail and lower violet tail stay clearly separated. Small fins paddle gently. Keep the head nearly still and every feature and color unchanged. Seamless calm 16-frame loop, stable sprite position and scale. No turning, no camera motion, no new objects, no particles, no stretching or extra tails.
subject_description: a slender silver-blue fantasy saury with two separate crescent tails, upper cyan and lower violet
initial_pose: horizontal neutral swimming pose, small pointed head at LEFT, two branching tails at RIGHT
